questions.question: A New Testament letter tells believers not to believe every spirit. What does it say they should do instead?

answers.text: Test them to see if they are from God
Stay far away from every spirit
Trust the one that sounds the kindest

questions.question: A New Testament letter gives a test for the Spirit of God. What does every spirit from God confess about Jesus Christ?

answers.text: He has come in the flesh
He has not yet come to earth
He is an angel from heaven

questions.question: A New Testament letter says believers had heard the spirit of the antichrist was coming. When does the letter say it is in the world?

answers.text: It is already here right now
It came and went long ago
It is still many years away

questions.question: A New Testament letter tells believers they are from God and have overcome. What reason does it give?

answers.text: Someone greater is in them than in the world
The false prophets are from God as well
They were taught better than the false prophets
